changes.current_line: Proven ROI, backed by an independent economic impact study.
changes.change: For finance-led buyers: 'Send us one month of your bank and processor statements and we'll show you what manual reconciliation costs you, in your numbers, not an industry average.' Build the model with their controller in the room.
changes.why: The deal went from 'Dead, honestly' to signed when the cost of manual matching was built from the customer's own statements, and the CFO accepted it as 'that's my number, not yours', which rejects the someone-else's-study proof that M6 offers.

changes.current_line: Financial infrastructure to grow globally, in every currency.
changes.change: For finance-led buyers (CFO or controller), open with their problem in their words and lead straight into reconciliation (M9): 'Know where your money is. Every deposit matched to its invoices before month-end, so close isn't a week of archaeology.'
changes.why: The decider described her problem as 'I just want to know where my money is' and 'month-end is a week of archaeology', nobody in the deal said 'infrastructure', the standard opener drew silence, and payout reconciliation was the only thing that drew a reaction.

changes.current_line: Built for developers: launch payments fast with our APIs, docs and sandbox.
changes.change: Don't lead with developer, API or checkout content when the buyer's IT team isn't building software or runs an off-the-shelf platform with a plugin. Keep it out of the first page of any proposal that may be forwarded to finance.
changes.why: The standard deck drew silence with an IT team that 'aren't building anything', and the APIs-and-checkout proposal was forwarded to the CFO, who read the first page and said it wasn't her problem.

changes.current_line: Trusted by leading businesses; see our customer stories.
changes.change: Add a distributor/wholesale customer story (invoice-driven business) with a reference customer willing to take calls from finance buyers. Until one exists, don't send retail stories to invoice-driven distributors.
changes.why: The CFO asked to talk to another distributor, dismissed the retail story we sent with 'this is a company that sells sweaters', and raised the missing reference twice.
